name: Baked Turkey Meatballs with Spicy Tomato Sauce & Blue Cheese Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Place tomato sauce and hot sauce in a large baking dish. Stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
¼ cup hot sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place turkey, bread crumbs, oil, garlic powder, and salt in a large bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ground turkey
1 cup panko bread crumbs
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Using a scant ¼-cup measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs. Transfer to the baking dish with the sauce and turn to coat.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring meatballs once, until golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and thinly slice green onions crosswise. Place half in a clean large bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Wash, dry, trim, and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl with the green onions.
Add cabbage, dressing, and almonds to the bowl. Stir to combine the slaw.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
¾ cup blue cheese dressing
⅓ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide saucy meatballs and slaw between plates. Top meatballs with reserved green onions and enjoy!
